# FocalCut
> FocalCut is a short-form video editing studio operated by Big Bay Mall LLC (Wyoming, USA). It edits TikTok videos, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for creators, coaches, e-commerce brands and real estate professionals.

## Services
- Short-form video editing (15-30s): hook optimization, retention pacing, captions, sound design, brand styling, platform-native 9:16 export.

## Pricing (one-time packages, not subscriptions)
- The Starter: $149 for 4 edited videos, 48h first-draft turnaround.
- Consistency Builder: $299 for 10 edited videos, 48h first-draft turnaround, 1 revision round per video.
- The Growth Engine: $399 for 15 edited videos, 24h first-draft turnaround, 2 revision rounds per video.

## How it works
1. Client purchases a package via Stripe. 2. Client receives a private dashboard link by email. 3. Client submits footage via Google Drive/Dropbox link. 4. FocalCut edits and delivers a first draft in 24-48h. 5. Client approves or requests revisions in the dashboard. 6. Final MP4s delivered to client Drive.
